column1: # The Stage 2 pair's undefended-branch ledger (#1408, parent #1401).
# Per function of bootstrap/stage2/compiler.c, how many of its branches
# nothing this repository runs ever takes -- once under each host compiler of
# the diverse pair. That set is where a divergence between compiler.kofun and
# its hand-maintained compiler.c transliteration can hide.
# A LISTED FUNCTION IS NOT WRONG. It is unwatched.
#   measured at   6ee19d952020f7429f0fe055863e9e7ae0e5ec8d
#   clang         clang version 22.1.8
#   basis         the union of 155 verify drivers and 1258 pinned *.kofun inputs,
#                 per drivers.tsv and inputs.tsv at this commit
#   totals        1911 untaken under gcc, 1823 under clang, across 354 functions
# COST, measured on this run rather than estimated -- it is the number the
# `verify`-or-not argument in tooling/gate-reachability/unreachable.tsv rests
# on, and the reason that file rather than the verify list is where this gate
# is accounted for:
#   gcc    drivers  4502s + corpus  767s =   88 min, drivers are 85% of it
#   clang  drivers  4681s + corpus  729s =   90 min, drivers are 86% of it
#   both   drivers  9183s + corpus 1496s =  178 min for the pair
#   8 cores; .
#   The sampler covered 0 of the 186 minutes this run took, so those are
#   sampled extremes and not the run maximum -- load 24.9 was observed by
#   hand during a window the sampler was not running.
# READ THE RATIO, NOT THE ABSOLUTE. These timings were taken on a shared
# machine with other sessions building concurrently, so the wall-clock
# figures are an upper bound rather than a clean-machine cost. The split
# between the driver phase and the corpus phase is what the cost argument
# turns on, and a ratio between two phases measured under the same
# contention survives it.
# Regenerate with:
#   sh tests/pair-coverage/check.sh --count
# Regeneration is deliberately manual: the number moving is the event this
# file exists to make visible. `sh tests/pair-coverage/check.sh` holds it
# exact in both directions -- more untaken than recorded is a regression,
# fewer is an improvement nobody wrote down.
# gcc
